title: Household Price of an Alignment Services & Plans Lifetime Plan
content:
**The household price of an Alignment Services & Plans household plan is the line's plan price reduced by the household rate of 10%, rounded to the nearest cent.** The plan price is that of the household plan's line on the product's line card.

| Plan price (hypothetical figure) | Household rate | Household price |
|---|---|---|
| 200.00 | 10% | 200.00 less 20.00: 180.00 |
| 150.37 | 10% | 150.37 less 15.037: 135.333, rounded to 135.33 |

The rate acts once on the plan price, and the result is rounded to the nearest cent.
